name: Lilithmon
main_effect:
[On Play] Trash the top 4 cards of your deck. Then, add up to 2 cards with [Bagra Army] in one of their traits from your trash to your hand, and place up to 2 Digimon cards with the [Bagra Army] trait from your trash under 1 of your Tamers.
[Opponent's Turn] When your opponent moves a Digimon from their breeding area, by trashing 1 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, that Digimon gains "[When Attacking] Lose 3 memory" for the turn.
